rounds.title: The Last Night at Hollow House
rounds.subtitle: Round 1

screens.intro: Thirty years ago tonight, the Vance family vanished from Hollow House. Police found no bodies, no struggle, and one torn photograph. At 11:00 PM a message appeared on the dead computer: TEN FRAGMENTS. TEN SEALS. ONE DOOR. At midnight, the house opens. If the picture is incomplete, it will leave. You are the digital investigators. Reconstruct the photograph before midnight.
victory_lines: Thank you for returning what was stolen.
screens.bridge_text: You escaped the house. You did not escape the experiment. The house was the first lock. The archive holds the truth. If you want to finish what you started, follow the evidence. - CIPHER
screens.eliminated_text: The house keeps what it keeps. Your investigation ends here tonight. Thank you for playing.

screens.intro: The qualifying teams are announced. The screen glitches. A doorway opens behind the photograph. You now have access to the abandoned underground archive beneath Hollow House. Find out what the family was hiding, identify what you accidentally activated, and contain it before midnight. Not everything you read here is true.
screens.bridge_text: If you're hearing this, you found the truth. The house was never the prison. It was the test. And you were never meant to find the archive.

clues.title: Lena's Diary
clues.scene_text: A diary in the dark. Its last pages were torn out and scattered.

stages.prompt: Lena's last entry points to one place in the house. Which one? (one word)

hints.text: Some sentences are written to be read. Others are written to be walked through, one step at a time.
A birthday tells you how many steps a house takes in one night.
Turn back, as many times as there were candles on that cake.

reward.story_text: Lena underlined one place twice in the margin.

hint_details.location_prop: Lena's Diary on the bedroom desk.
hint_details.guidance: Shift each ciphertext letter backward by Lena's age (14th birthday) to decipher the cleartext phrase.

clues.title: Lena's Notebook

reward.story_text: Dad's rule was written in pencil: the house keeps its own hour.

hint_details.location_prop: Lena's Notebook beside the bedside nightstand.
hint_details.guidance: Count the paper origami cranes folded for mother, then reverse each letter shift by that exact count.

clues.title: Containment Terminal
clues.scene_text: The last door. Three stages stand between you and midnight.

assets.brief: Assembled family portrait, five people, four shadows, fifth figure faceless. Faint text '7351' near the fifth figure at about 6 percent contrast.
The portrait cut into a 2x5 grid with torn edges, exported as ten PNGs matching the photo_pieces list.

stages.prompt: Enter the three words the house has given you.
Arrange the ten photograph pieces.
The photograph is whole. Choose, then enter the code hidden in the picture.

hints.text: The door asks for three words you have already been given.
One from a girl's page, one from a machine's last words, one from a guest who should not exist.
In the order the door asks.
Ten pieces, ten cases.
Every torn edge remembers its neighbour.
Where the floor begins, the bottom row begins.
Count the living. Count what they cast.
One of the voices lied. One of the notes did not.
Follow the honest paper. The number hides near the face that is not there.

reward.story_text: The door opens. The countdown stops. The house goes silent.

hint_details.guidance: Stage 1: Enter the 3 clearance keywords uncovered across your investigation (from Bedroom and Study). Stage 2: Reconstruct the 10 severed photograph pieces into the 2×5 grid. Stage 3: Choose the protocol and enter the security PIN.

reward.story_text: One badge kept working after the lab was officially closed.

assets.brief: Static with spectrogram text 6072 drawn between 2 and 8 kHz (the decoy).
Static with spectrogram text 6027 drawn between 2 and 8 kHz (the real sender).

stages.prompt: Enter the four digits hidden in the real sender's voicemail.

hints.text: The static is drawn, not random.
Sounds can be looked at. Use something that paints frequency over time.
The picture lives in the upper half of the sound. Only one voicemail came from the sender you trust.

reward.story_text: The Hollow One can fake a voice. It cannot fake a signal it does not know exists.

clues.title: Convergence Lock
clues.scene_text: A sealed bulkhead at the end of the Archive. Its keypad has two fields.

stages.prompt: Enter the panel code and the keyword.

hints.text: One number, one word. Both are already in your pockets.
The number lived inside a photograph. The word came from a list someone tried to corrupt.
Do not trust the order of the cards. Trust the dates.

reward.story_text: The bulkhead grinds open. The Containment Vault is now accessible.

clues.title: Manual Diff
clues.scene_text: Two copies of the shutdown manual. One is readable. One is encrypted. They should say the same thing.

manual_plain: STEP 1: CUT EXTERNAL POWER TO THE VAULT RING
STEP 8: PRESERVE THE LINK TO HOLLOW HOUSE

stages.prompt: Which step numbers were tampered with? (digits, ascending, for example 134)

reveal.clean_steps_text: The original manual is intact. Only the changed steps were poisoned.

hints.text: Two manuals, one story.
The sealed copy only opens for the word the report buried under black ink. Read both, line against line.
Count the lines that disagree.

reward.story_text: Someone rewrote the shutdown manual to keep the link alive.

clues.title: Failsafe Circuit
clues.scene_text: A panel of logic gates. Eight inputs, four lamps.

payload.panel_note: Four digits feed four input pairs (A, B, C, D). Each pair is the last two bits of that digit in binary. The code is lamps 1 to 4, left to right.

stages.prompt: Enter the 4-digit authorization code shown by the lamps.

hints.text: Numbers become switches if you look at their last footprints.
Write the voicemail digits in base two and keep only the tail of each.
Four pairs, eight wires, four lamps. Trace each lamp back to its inputs.

reward.story_text: The failsafe lamps light in sequence. The authorization code is yours.

clues.title: Final Containment
clues.scene_text: The central console. Three entries stand between you and the end.

stages.prompt: Enter the clean step numbers, the authorization code and the real sender's badge.

hints.text: Everything has already been decided. You only have to carry it here.
One entry is what stayed untouched, one is what the lamps showed, one belongs to the voice you trusted.
Of the eight steps, remove those the manuals disagreed on.

reward.story_text: The countdown freezes. The connection to Hollow House terminates.
